title: Reusable LLM-Based Plans with Probabilistic Guarantees for Self-Adaptive Systems
title_zh: 具有概率保证的可复用基于LLM的自适应系统规划

paragraphs.en: 提出验证器引导的LLM控制器复用框架，结合概率模型检测为实例族提供概率保证，验证速度比逐实例合成快15到103倍。 Self-adaptive systems are designed to accommodate variants of their environment, which form a family of instances whose uncertainty is captured by probabilistic models, and must meet probabilistic requirements on each instance. Within such a family, changes in size and structure complicate the fundamental adaptation decision: whether to retain, reuse, or construct a new controller, since controllers are often synthesized for and specific to an instance. Large language models (LLMs) have recently been used to write reusable controllers, but existing approaches largely target deterministic domains, and probabilistic model checking of their output remains limited to preliminary single-instance studies. In this paper, we propose a verifier-guided framework for controller reuse with explicit support for families of environments. The framework introduces a novel combination of LLM-written controllers with probabilistic model checking to provide per-instance guarantees for probabilistic requirements. We evaluate our approach using three LLMs on three benchmarks, assessing its effectiveness and cost with respect to baseline implementations, the distribution of adaptation decisions, and the impact of individual framework components. On grid worlds, LLM-written rule lists are verified on about 90% of held-out instances, against at most 77% for the baselines, and verifying a stored rule list is 15 to 103 times faster than per-instance synthesis. Reuse serves most episodes at a small fraction of the cost of generation or per-instance synthesis, and model-checking feedback increases verified coverage over independent restarts.
paragraphs.zh: 提出验证器引导的LLM控制器复用框架，结合概率模型检测为实例族提供概率保证，验证速度比逐实例合成快15到103倍。自适应系统旨在适应其环境的各种变体，这些变体构成一个实例族，其不确定性由概率模型刻画，并且必须在每个实例上满足概率需求。 在这样一个实例族中，规模与结构的变化使基本的适应决策变得复杂：是保留、复用还是构建新的控制器，因为控制器通常是为某个实例合成的且仅适用于该实例。 大语言模型（LLMs）近来已被用于编写可复用的控制器，但现有方法主要面向确定性领域，且对其输出的概率模型检测仍局限于初步的单实例研究。 在本文中，我们提出一个验证器引导的控制器复用框架，明确支持环境族。 该框架将LLM编写的控制器与概率模型检测以新颖的方式结合，为概率需求提供逐实例保证。 我们在三个基准上使用三个LLM评估我们的方法，对照基线实现评估其有效性与成本，分析适应决策的分布，以及各框架组件的影响。 在网格世界上，LLM编写的规则列表在约90%的保留实例上通过验证，而基线最多为77%，且验证已存储的规则列表比逐实例合成快15到103倍。 复用以生成或逐实例合成成本的一小部分服务于大多数回合，而模型检测反馈相比独立重启提高了经验证的覆盖率。
